evidence.quote: A total of 54 pregnant women were included in this study with 18 PTB subjects and 36 matching controls.
the V1-V3 regions of the 16S rDNA were amplified using 27F forward primers
To rule out the possibility of contamination, we run water samples as negative controls
In this study, our negative controls were not sequenced, and the risk of contamination was mainly assessed using computational methods.

notes: Placenta from 54 women (18 PTB, 36 TB); 6 with membrane rupture >18 h excluded, so ~48 placentas (n inferred). Saliva and vaginal samples not extracted. FEAST source tracking used (unknown source 17-29%), not removal. Water controls run but explicitly not sequenced. top5 from 'most prevalent genera' list (order as written). Candidatus Saccharimonas not recorded.
